text: This preliminary study examines the impact of red versus blue light on seedling development. Due to the limited sample size, findings should be interpreted with caution. Results indicate distinct morphological differences between groups, suggesting wavelength significantly influences early growth patterns. Further research with larger cohorts is necessary to validate these initial observations and establish statistical significance.
